description: Lists projects from mite, active ones or with `archived: true` the archived ones; use it to look up project ids for filters such as `project_id` in `mite_list_time_entries`, for budget usage use `mite_report_budget`. Returns id, name, customer, archived flag, note, `budget` and `budget_type`; `budget` is in the unit given by `budget_type` (minutes or cents), not hours or currency units. The whole list is returned at once without paging.

archived.description: true = list archived entries instead of the active ones, e.g. true. Default: false.

name: mite_list_projects
title: List projects
